originalTitle: 'The Fed put is very much back': Wall Street strategists weigh central bank's next move
summary: Stocks have been shaky as technology takes a hit, but the Fed's latest move to hold rates steady signals that policymakers will support the markets if the going gets tough.
content:
Wednesday's Fed decision this week to keep interest rates unchanged despite sticky inflation fueled by oil prices above $100 per barrel was a head-scratcher for more than one Wall Street strategist.

"In our view, the decision was puzzling," Ed Yardeni of Yardeni Research wrote last week.

"It reminds us of someone standing in a room with a fire alarm blaring and smoke pouring under the door, yet insisting on more evidence before calling the fire department," he noted, highlighting that the US economy increased at a 3.4% annualized rate in the third quarter.

Others have questioned whether the Fed put — in which the central bank would step in to support financial markets by lowering interest rates or providing liquidity amid declining asset prices — could come into play.

Read more:  How jobs, inflation, and the Fed are all related

"The Fed put is very much back," Darius Dale, founder of 42 Macro, said on Yahoo Finance on Thursday. Dale expects that, going forward, policy will include greater coordination between the Federal Reserve and the Treasury to influence the bond market, the government's means of issuing debt.

That coordination could include officials eventually stepping in to buy back government bonds using cash backed by the Fed, giving policymakers extra firepower to calm nervous bond markets and provide a liquidity boost next year.

Read more:  How soaring Treasury yields could hit your finances

That prospect helps explain why investors have continued to shift between stock market sectors rather than suffer a broader sell-off, despite concerns about inflation, interest rates, and AI jitters.

"This is a market that continues to rotate instead of go down," Dale said. "The market might be looking — eyes on the prize — at a liquidity rescue in 2027."

Indeed, most of the sell-off in recent sessions has happened in tech. Worries over AI funding and the impact of artificial intelligence on businesses such as Google ( GOOG , GOOGL ) search software have left certain pockets of the AI trade reeling. Quarterly prints from Intel ( INTC ) and Amazon ( AMZN ) have put pressure on the AI trade.

Meanwhile, Healthcare ( XLV ), Financial Services ( XLF ), and Real Estate ( XLRE ) saw gains last week. Over the past month, every other sector but Technology ( XLK ) and Communications Services ( XLC ) has rallied, according to Yahoo Finance's AlphaSpace data.

"Beneath the hood, the fundamentals of this AI wave still remain really robust," Stephanie Aliaga, global market strategist at JPMorgan Global Asset Management, told Yahoo Finance.

"But we are entering a more discerning phase of this AI trade, and not every company is going to shine as bright, particularly in an environment with higher financing costs," she added.

Aliaga said fixed income is an attractive time to add to portfolios, given bond yields.

UBS strategists also noted that high-quality bonds can help stabilize portfolios, with attractive yields providing investors with income even as bond prices fluctuate.

"We continue to see scope for equity gains overall and believe investors should focus on building a resilient portfolio that includes exposure beyond tech," said Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi, chief investment officer of the Americas and global head of equities at UBS.

Follow Ines Ferré on X at @ines_ferre .
chineseTitle: “美联储看跌期权已大幅回归”：华尔街策略师权衡央行下一步行动
chineseSummary: 由于科技受到打击，股市一直不稳定，但美联储维持利率稳定的最新举措表明，如果情况变得艰难，政策制定者将支持市场。
chineseContent:
周三，尽管油价超过每桶 100 美元，引发了粘性通胀，但美联储仍决定维持利率不变，这一决定令不止一位华尔街策略师感到头疼。

“我们认为，这个决定令人费解，”亚德尼研究中心的埃德·亚德尼上周写道。

他指出：“这让我们想起有人站在火警响起、门下冒出浓烟的房间里，却坚持在打电话给消防部门之前需要更多证据。”他强调，美国经济第三季度年化增长率为 3.4%。

其他人质疑美联储的投入——美联储将通过降低利率或在资产价格下跌的情况下提供流动性来介入支持金融市场——是否会发挥作用。

了解更多：就业、通胀和美联储之间的关系

42 Macro 创始人达里厄斯·戴尔 (Darius Dale) 周四在雅虎财经上表示：“美联储看跌期权已经大幅回归。”戴尔预计，未来的政策将包括美联储和财政部之间加强协调，以影响债券市场（政府发行债务的手段）。

这种协调可能包括官员最终介入，使用美联储支持的现金回购政府债券，从而为政策制定者提供额外的火力来平息紧张的债券市场，并在明年提供流动性提振。

阅读更多内容：国债收益率飙升如何影响您的财务状况

这种前景有助于解释为什么尽管人们担心通胀、利率和人工智能的不安，但投资者仍继续在股市板块之间转换，而不是遭受更广泛的抛售。

“这是一个继续旋转而不是下跌的市场，”戴尔说。 “市场可能会关注——着眼于——2027 年的流动性救援。”

事实上，最近几个交易日的大部分抛售都发生在科技领域。对人工智能资金的担忧以及人工智能对谷歌（GOOG，GOOGL）搜索软件等企业的影响已经让人工智能贸易的某些领域陷入困境。英特尔（INTC）和亚马逊（AMZN）的季度报告给人工智能行业带来了压力。

与此同时，医疗保健 (XLV)、金融服务 (XLF) 和房地产 (XLRE) 上周出现上涨。根据雅虎财经的 AlphaSpace 数据，过去一个月，除科技 (XLK) 和通信服务 (XLC) 之外的所有其他板块均出现上涨。

摩根大通全球资产管理公司全球市场策略师斯蒂芬妮·阿利亚加（Stephanie Aliaga）告诉雅虎财经：“在幕后，人工智能浪潮的基本面仍然非常强劲。”

“但我们正在进入人工智能行业更加挑剔的阶段，并不是每家公司都会如此耀眼，特别是在融资成本较高的环境下，”她补充道。

阿利亚加表示，考虑到债券收益率，固定收益是增加投资组合的有吸引力的时机。

瑞银策略师还指出，高质量债券有助于稳定投资组合，即使债券价格波动，有吸引力的收益率也能为投资者提供收入。

瑞银美洲首席投资官兼全球股票主管乌尔里克·霍夫曼-布尔查迪 (Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi) 表示：“我们继续看到股票整体上涨的空间，并认为投资者应该专注于建立一个有弹性的投资组合，其中包括科技以外的投资。”
